code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            target_value = 8 if value == 1 else 4 if value == 7 else None
            if target_value is None:
                continue
            targets = [j for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == target_value]
            if not targets:
                continue
            j = min(targets, key=lambda j: abs(j-c))
            if abs(j-c) > 1:
                out[r][c] = 0
                out[r][j + (1 if j < c else -1)] = value
    return out
'''
